judged_text: The dialog hand-maintains a private ZAddGuestsInputSchema (a bare email array with a uniqueness refine) alongside the router's identically-named ZAddGuestsInputSchema (an object with bookingId and no refine) in addGuests.schema.ts — two divergent copies of one contract shipped in the same PR. The copies already disagree in this diff (the client enforces uniqueness, the server does not), so the next engineer tightening email rules updates one schema and not the other, and any test importing 'the schema' validates against whichever copy it happens to reach rather than the contract the API actually enforces; deleting the inline schema and importing a single shared definition removes a place-to-update and one of the two validation paths.
